ESR-10 — the fee multiplier and the rung mix, on both w_ref arms
(ECONOMICS_SIM_PRODUCTION_REBASE.md §5.29; ESR10_PREDICTIONS.md). Every cell is production but for
its named alternatives; every scenario folds to 60 y.
ARMS:
  inherited   w_ref 3000 B, zone 300000 B: the run's own.
  re-derived  declared; the owners' ruling replaces it (EUP-5 G). w_ref' = 12595 B, the ordinary
              1in/2out weight at genesis tree depth 1 at its own genesis Standard fee 0.3277 SKL
              (a fixed point: 2 pass(es) from the zero-fee weight); zone' = 100 x w_ref' = 1259500 B,
              the inherited ratio. --set relay.ref_tx_weight=12595 --set economic.full_reward_zone=1259500
CELLS: x1.000 all-Standard, x1.250 all-Standard, x1.352 all-Standard (m*), x1.500 all-Standard, x2.000 all-Standard, x3.000 all-Standard, 15/80/5 x1.000, 15/85/0 x1.000.
  m* = ceil(1000 theta(y1)/rho(y1)) on the inherited arm's year 1. Mixes are Economy/Standard/Priority
  percent; demand splits by largest remainder on the cumulative target, and one block's arrivals are
  admitted Priority, Standard, Economy: a declared order, which can move the pool (§5.29).
CEILING (umbrella §4, ratified 2026-11-06): the year-1 Standard fee <= 0.05% of the year-1 mean block
  reward on the design curve = 496289839 atomic (0.4963 SKL). The year-1 Standard fee is the Standard
  fees carried in year 1 over the Standard transactions carried.
READING: grows = the year carried first passes the constrained ceiling by more than one tx/block;
  empties = the first year whose last block leaves nothing waiting; Econ served = Economy carried /
  demanded over 60 y; onset = A1-T's first sustained year under 1 at 10% (flat-25, best).
